title: Rezk local model structure and box pushout product
statement:
Use small simplicial sets, spaces, quasicategories and coherent functors of [def-cbc-enhanced-diagrams-cones], the model-category and coherent-localization conventions of [lem-coef-model-infinity-derived-adjunction], the simplicial-model-category enrichment, tensor, cotensor and lifting-axiom conventions of [lem-coef-simplicial-model-nerve-localization], the Joyal model structure of [lem-coef-joyal-model-structure], and the Kan model structure of [lem-coef-kan-quillen-right-proper]. Work in fixed nested universes. A simplicial space is a bisimplicial set $X_{p,q}$, with $X_p=X_{p,\bullet}$. Its vertical Reedy fibrancy means that $X_n\to M_nX$ is a Kan fibration for every $n\geq0$, where $M_nX$ is the limit of the restrictions $X_k$ along all proper injective maps $[k]\hookrightarrow[n]$. Use the homotopy Segal condition and homotopy category $hX$ of [lem-coef-segal-dk-diagonal-equivalence]. Let $X_{\mathrm{eq}}\subseteq X_1$ be the union of components containing arrows invertible in $hX$. Say that $X$ is complete if $s_0:X_0\to X_{\mathrm{eq}}$ is a weak homotopy equivalence.

There is a simplicial model structure on bisimplicial sets, the Rezk model structure, with monomorphisms as cofibrations and vertically Reedy fibrant complete homotopy Segal spaces as fibrant objects. Its weak equivalences are precisely the maps $f:A\to B$ for which $\operatorname{Map}_{\mathrm{ss}}(B,Z)\to\operatorname{Map}_{\mathrm{ss}}(A,Z)$ is a weak homotopy equivalence for every fibrant $Z$, where $\operatorname{Map}_{\mathrm{ss}}(A,Z)_q=\operatorname{Hom}_{\mathrm{ss}}(A\times(\Delta^q)_{\mathrm{vert}},Z)$ and $(\Delta^q)_{\mathrm{vert}}$ is constant in the first variable. It has functorial factorizations. Objectwise passage to spaces on its fibrant objects identifies its homotopy coherent localization with the full infinity subcategory of $\operatorname{Fun}(\Delta^{\mathrm{op}},\mathrm{Spc})$ consisting of complete Segal objects, with all fiber products interpreted as homotopy fiber products. In particular this is a comparison of mapping spaces and coherent functors, not only of homotopy categories.

For simplicial sets $A,B$ put $(A\boxtimes B)_{p,q}=A_p\times B_q$. If $i:A\to A'$ is a Joyal cofibration and $j:B\to B'$ is a Kan cofibration, then
$$ (A'\boxtimes B)\amalg_{A\boxtimes B}(A\boxtimes B')\longrightarrow A'\boxtimes B' $$
is a Rezk cofibration, and is a Rezk weak equivalence if either $i$ is a Joyal weak equivalence or $j$ is a Kan weak equivalence.

reviewed_lean.note: Delivery changes only the item node's lean record plus stmt_deps (adds the landed def-coef-segal-space) and the new module RezkLocalModel.lean. Statement verbatim, no statement_change. Checked every clause: ModelCategory on SimplexCategoryᵒᵖ⥤SSet with vertical-first storage (uncurry∘flip gives the outer-first SegalSpace.Space convention); cofibrations iff Mono; fibrant iff SegalSpace.IsComplete (Reedy matching against J.rlp for all n including 0; strict Segal maps equivalent to homotopy Segal for Reedy-fibrant objects; equivalence components; actual s0); weak equivalences iff the native vertical enrichment eHomWhiskerRight is a weak homotopy equivalence for every complete Z; both functorial factorizations; tensor/cotensor plus SatisfiesSM7; LocalizationClause with q normalized by IsOrdinaryNerveMap and Q an IsLocalization at M's W into the M-independent completeSegalObjects subcomplex, restricting to the objectwise comparison; box/boxMap/boxPushout canonical; Mono i/j as Joyal/Kan cofibrations; acyclicity via the exact Joyal (v=0) and Kan tests. Edge cases (empty, terminal, identity, n=0, any universe u) covered. No hollow definitions; the only sorry is the main theorem; docstrings carry source and blueprint; no other complete-Segal-object notion in the project. nt_compile --json on the snapshot module: clean, 1.5 s, rc 0, no diagnostics.

lean.statement: theorem exists_rezk_model_structure : ∃ M : ModelCategory Bisimplicial.{u}, (∀ {A B : Bisimplicial.{u}} (f : A ⟶ B), M.categoryWithCofibrations.cofibrations f ↔ Mono f) ∧ (∀ X : Bisimplicial.{u}, M.categoryWithFibrations.fibrations (terminal.from X) ↔ CategoryTheory.SegalSpace.IsComplete (Functor.uncurry.obj X.flip)) ∧ (∀ {A B : Bisimplicial.{u}} (f : A ⟶ B), M.categoryWithWeakEquivalences.weakEquivalences f ↔ ∀ Z : Bisimplicial.{u}, CategoryTheory.SegalSpace.IsComplete (Functor.uncurry.obj Z.flip) → Enhanced.IsWeakHomotopyEquivalence (eHomWhiskerRight SSet f Z)) ∧ MorphismProperty.HasFunctorialFactorization M.categoryWithCofibrations.cofibrations (M.categoryWithFibrations.fibrations ⊓ M.categoryWithWeakEquivalences.weakEquivalences) ∧ MorphismProperty.HasFunctorialFactorization (M.categoryWithCofibrations.cofibrations ⊓ M.categoryWithWeakEquivalences.weakEquivalences) M.categoryWithFibrations.fibrations ∧ SimplicialClause M ∧ LocalizationClause M.categoryWithWeakEquivalences.weakEquivalences ∧ (∀ {A A' B B' : SSet.{u}} (i : A ⟶ A') (j : B ⟶ B'), Mono i → Mono j → M.categoryWithCofibrations.cofibrations (boxPushout i j) ∧ (((∀ C : SSet.{u}, C.Quasicategory → ((hoFunctor.map ((MonoidalClosed.pre i).app C)).toFunctor).IsEquivalence) ∨ Enhanced.IsWeakHomotopyEquivalence j) → M.categoryWithWeakEquivalences.weakEquivalences (boxPushout i j)))
lean.note: Vertical-first storage uses Mathlib's native simplicial-object enrichment in the correct direction; flip/uncurry give the recorded outer-first Segal-space definitions. Added landed def-coef-segal-space instead of copying Reedy fibrancy, equivalence components or completeness. The full coherent presheaf subcategory is presented by strict complete Segal representatives and saturated under equivalence independently of the Rezk weak-equivalence class. The localization map is normalized on the entire ordinary nerve of the fibrant objects. All helpers are explicit constructions for this node; only the main theorem is postponed.
